FOLLOW YOUR CURIOSITY

Fresh air.
Endless possibilities.

Fill your day with adventure, or leave a little room for doing nothing.

BY THE WATER

Make it a lake day.

Enjoy kayaking and canoeing, bring your fishing pole, or settle in lakeside with a favorite book. Finish the day with stories around the fire.

OUTSIDE IS CALLING

A different kind of play.

Explore the 200-acre property on hiking and biking trails. Enjoy mini golf, horseshoes, and lawn games, or ask about staff-led archery and axe throwing for ages 12 and up.

Activity availability and schedules vary. Please contact the retreat to plan your visit.

GATHER AROUND THE TABLE

Leave room for good food.

Onsite breakfast, lunch, and dinner options make it easy to spend more time together. Ask our team about dining schedules, meal plans, and arrangements for your group.
